0.3.1-beta.8.text:
Beta 8 of 0.3.1: a Test channel for admins, and the weather found from the site's address.

- System > Updates: a Test channel beside Stable and Beta, for admins only ("Bench builds, not soaked."). A unit whose override URL was its own test channel now shows Test, with the override empty.
- Weather: no more typing latitude and longitude. Turning the weather on looks up the site's Location (Settings > Device and site) and shows what it found, such as "Found: Ottawa, Ontario, Canada"; saving a new Location looks it up again. Coordinates can still be typed under Advanced when the lookup fails.

0.3.1-beta.7.text:
Beta 7 of 0.3.1: a fix, with everything of beta 6.

- DHC link: a unit restarted while remote access was on "until turned off" could restart over and over. Fixed; beta 4 to 6 have the bug, so update before turning remote access on until turned off.
- Everything of beta 6: binary values in the object's own words on drawings, help for the equipment pages, the 30-day cap of "until turned off", DHC's link roots.

0.3.1-beta.3.text:
Beta 3 of 0.3.1: equipment templates (one drawing per equipment type, shared by every device of that type) and floor plans with live device markers.

- Equipment types (Graphics > Equipment types, admin): pick a drawing (VAV, rooftop unit, AHU, MUA, chiller, pump), map its values once to the objects of a sample device, tick the devices of that type. Each device then opens the same drawing with its own values.
- A value with nothing mapped hides; a value without a reading shows a dash; a value older than a minute is greyed.
- Setpoints: operators and admins write a mapped setpoint within the type's min and max at its priority; viewers read it only.
- Floor plans: on a graphic, Markers places a marker for a discovered device by dragging it, on a phone or a laptop. A marker shows the device name and its value; grey when the device is offline, amber or red while it has an active alarm. A tap opens the device's drawing.
- Drawings and plans pan and pinch-zoom on a phone. The unit reads a page's points only while it is open.

0.3.1-beta.2.text:
Beta 2 of 0.3.1: operators and viewers get a site menu of Home, Graphics, Points, Schedules, Alarms and Trends, and land on Home with the graphics.

- Operator and viewer: the menu is Home, Graphics (with the site's pages), Points, Schedules, Alarms and Trends; the phone bar is Home, Graphics, Points, Alarms and Menu. Home lists the graphics first and leaves out the technical cards. A viewer's pages stay read-only.
- Admin, and everyone on a unit without users: the menu and Home are as before.
- Everything in 0.3.1-beta.1: the SlateBAS Edge brand and the slatebas1 access point password for new units.

0.3.1-beta.1.text:
Beta 1 of 0.3.1: the firmware is now SlateBAS Edge, with the SlateBAS logo in the header and a new factory Wi-Fi password for new units.

- The header shows the SlateBAS logo, "SlateBAS Edge" and the site name. The model (SlateTap ST-1) and the firmware version are on System > Status, the login page, the first screen of the setup wizard and the OLED splash.
- The pages say "this unit" where they used to say "SlateTap".
- New units: the access point password is slatebas1. A unit that already has a password keeps it, and a unit that ran an earlier firmware without setting one keeps slatetap1. A factory reset sets slatebas1.
- BACnet: Model_Name is still the model (SlateTap ST-1). The device name, the access point name and the host name do not change.

0.3.0-rc.1.text:
Release candidate 1 of 0.3.0: signed updates and signed install files, a storage reserve, MQTT writes to tagged points only, network fixes and the pre-release hardening.

- Updates are signed by DHC: the unit checks the signature before it downloads anything. Install by file takes DHC's signed release files only (the signature is inside each file); files of older releases are refused. To go back to 0.2.0 by file, use the signed copies slatetap-0.2.0-signed.bin and www-0.2.0-signed.bin from this release.
- Storage: 512 KB stay free so settings, users and alarms can always be saved; trend history shrinks first. System > Storage shows each store against its cap, and a banner warns while memory is low or storage is nearly full.
- MQTT: writes reach only points tagged mqtt-write. BACnet/SC: a warning alarm when no hub has been connected for 10 minutes.
- BACnet/IP: the broadcast table can no longer be rewritten from the network, and foreign devices register only with BBMD and their acceptance on.
- After a Wi-Fi outage, MQTT, BACnet/SC and the fleet heartbeat come back within seconds; a cut web app upload leaves a recovery page, and the unit restores its web app by itself.
- System > Status: an LED legend and a Board card. A firmware file or backup made for another product is refused, with the reason.
- Logic on a phone: a tap on a block opens its settings and help. Deleting a program right after the schedules that wrote its points no longer floods the log.
- An empty access point password left by 0.2.0 becomes the factory default, with a banner until a new one is saved.

0.3.0-beta.5.101.text: Bench test build of signed online updates: each update image carries an ed25519 signature that the unit checks before it downloads anything. Not for sites.

0.3.0-beta.5.text:
Phase E of 0.3.0: the tech tool. An MS/TP analyzer with a capture for Wireshark, a Modbus frame log, OLED alarm and update cards, and a printable commissioning report.

- MS/TP analyzer (System > Support): always on while MS/TP runs. A bus verdict over the last 10 minutes, every station with its timings against the standard limits, and the SlateTap's own pauses counted apart from the bus.
- Capture: record the trunk into memory and download a .pcap for Wireshark; "stop after an error" keeps the frames around an intermittent fault.
- Modbus frame log: what the SlateTap sends on RS485 and what comes back, with the bytes, for 1 to 60 minutes; text and CSV downloads.
- OLED: an Alarms card while an alarm is listed (a new critical or warning alarm takes the screen briefly), an Update card, Updating with its progress during an install, and the bus verdict on the MS/TP card.
- Commissioning report: a printable record of the set-up (Print, or Save as PDF), without passwords, tokens or keys. Every page now prints in a light theme.
- The diagnostics file now carries the analyzer, the capture state and the frame logs.
- RS485: the SlateTap no longer holds the trunk while it saves to flash (its UART keeps working through the write), and after its own pauses it never answers a token the bus has moved past.

0.2.0.text:
SlateTap 0.2.0: point-aware Logic, the site database, a BACnet server with router and BBMD, Modbus RTU and TCP, graphics, trends, alarms and the update check.

- Live, point-aware Logic with virtual points and 17 new blocks.
- Site database.
- BACnet server, router and BBMD.
- Modbus RTU and TCP.
- Internet sharing (NAT) and time.
- Graphics, trends and alarms.
- Fleet heartbeat and update check.
- From 0.1.0 by file (Settings > Firmware update): back up first, then the firmware image, then the web app image. Settings, pinned points and programs are kept.
- Not proven yet: the MS/TP side of the router, Modbus RTU on a real wire.
